verdict_summary: E-FRAC-54: Monoalphabetic preprocessing + transposition + running-key decryption is UNDERDETERMINED, NOT eliminated. The 13 monoalphabetic degrees of freedom saturate quadgram discrimination at n=97, so the fragment-analysis scoring path cannot distinguish real English running keys from gibberish when a monoalphabetic preprocessing layer is present. Requires a scoring path that beats FM-1 at n=97 to test. This is the project's only legitimate algebraic-class open frontier; it remains OPEN.
scope_caveats: Detection-limited, not search-limited. The genuine algebraic open frontier.
The 13 monoalphabetic DOF saturate fragment discrimination at n=97.
scope_does_not_cover: Nothing is eliminated by this entry — it is an OPEN marker.
